# TradingView
> TradingView is a charting, market data, screening, and social analysis platform for tracking and trading global financial markets.

TradingView combines advanced web-based charts, real-time and delayed market data, technical indicators, alerts, screeners, economic calendars, broker integrations, and a large community publishing ideas, scripts, and market analysis across stocks, futures, forex, crypto, indices, and bonds.

## Core Platform
- [TradingView Home](https://www.tradingview.com/): Main entry point for charts, markets, screeners, ideas, and trading tools.
- [Features](https://www.tradingview.com/features/): Overview of charting, alerts, screeners, calendars, and collaboration capabilities.
- [Pricing](https://www.tradingview.com/pricing/): Subscription plans, feature limits, and paid tier comparisons.
- [Chart](https://www.tradingview.com/chart/): Interactive advanced charting workspace for analyzing any supported symbol.
- [Markets](https://www.tradingview.com/markets/): Market overview pages for stocks, crypto, forex, futures, and indices.
- [Screeners](https://www.tradingview.com/screener/): Access stock, ETF, forex, and crypto screening tools.
- [Economic Calendar](https://www.tradingview.com/economic-calendar/): Upcoming macroeconomic releases, central bank events, and market-impacting data.
- [Desktop App](https://www.tradingview.com/desktop/): Native desktop application for multi-monitor charting and trading workflows.

## Market Data & Quotes
- [Symbols](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/): Directory of tradable instruments, indices, and market benchmarks.
- [Stocks Market](https://www.tradingview.com/markets/stocks-usa/): U.S. stock market overview with movers, sectors, and watchlists.
- [Crypto Market](https://www.tradingview.com/markets/cryptocurrencies/): Cryptocurrency market overview with prices, dominance, and performance.
- [Forex Market](https://www.tradingview.com/markets/currencies/): Currency market overview with major, minor, and exotic pairs.
- [Futures Market](https://www.tradingview.com/markets/futures/): Futures quotes and market pages for commodities, rates, and indices.
- [Indices Market](https://www.tradingview.com/markets/indices/): Global index quotes, heatmaps, and benchmark tracking pages.
- [Bonds Market](https://www.tradingview.com/markets/bonds/): Government bond yields, prices, and fixed-income market overviews.
- [ETFs Market](https://www.tradingview.com/markets/etfs/): ETF market pages with fund quotes and category performance.

## Screeners & Calendars
- [Stock Screener](https://www.tradingview.com/stock-screener/): Filter equities by fundamentals, technicals, valuation, and performance metrics.
- [ETF Screener](https://www.tradingview.com/etf-screener/): Screen exchange-traded funds by issuer, asset class, and returns.
- [Crypto Coins Screener](https://www.tradingview.com/crypto-coins-screener/): Filter cryptocurrencies by market cap, volume, and technical conditions.
- [Forex Screener](https://www.tradingview.com/forex-screener/): Screen currency pairs using price action and technical indicators.
- [Economic Calendar](https://www.tradingview.com/economic-calendar/): Track scheduled economic releases and expected market impact.
- [Earnings Calendar](https://www.tradingview.com/earnings-calendar/): Upcoming company earnings dates, estimates, and announcements.
- [Dividends Calendar](https://www.tradingview.com/dividends-calendar/): Dividend schedules, ex-dates, and payout tracking for listed companies.
- [Splits Calendar](https://www.tradingview.com/splits-calendar/): Corporate action calendar for stock splits and reverse splits.

## Community & Social Analysis
- [Ideas](https://www.tradingview.com/ideas/): Community-published trade setups, chart analysis, and market commentary.
- [Editors' Picks](https://www.tradingview.com/ideas/editors-picks/): Curated selection of notable community ideas and analysis.
- [Streams](https://www.tradingview.com/streams/): Live streaming content from traders and market commentators.
- [Scripts](https://www.tradingview.com/scripts/): Public library of indicators, strategies, and Pine-based tools.
- [People](https://www.tradingview.com/people/): User profiles for analysts, script authors, and community contributors.
- [House Rules](https://www.tradingview.com/house-rules/): Community publishing and moderation rules for ideas, scripts, and interactions.
- [Moderators](https://www.tradingview.com/moderators/): Information about community moderation and platform governance.

## Pine Script & Developer Docs
- [Pine Script Overview](https://www.tradingview.com/pine-script-docs/en/v5/Introduction.html): Introduction to TradingView’s scripting language for indicators and strategies.
- [Pine Script Language Reference](https://www.tradingview.com/pine-script-reference/v5/): Complete reference for Pine Script functions, variables, and syntax.
- [Pine Script User Manual](https://www.tradingview.com/pine-script-docs/): Documentation hub for Pine Script concepts and examples.
- [Pine Editor](https://www.tradingview.com/pine-script-docs/en/v5/Language_Reference.html): Documentation entry point for writing and editing Pine code.
- [Lightweight Charts](https://www.tradingview.com/lightweight-charts/): Open-source charting library for embedding financial charts in web apps.
- [Trading Platform](https://www.tradingview.com/trading/): Broker integration and order execution features within TradingView.
- [Broker API](https://www.tradingview.com/broker-api/): Integration information for brokers connecting trading functionality to TradingView.
- [Widget Documentation](https://www.tradingview.com/widget/): Embeddable market widgets and chart components for websites.

## Widgets & Embeds
- [Widgets Home](https://www.tradingview.com/widget/): Overview of embeddable widgets for quotes, charts, and market data.
- [Advanced Chart Widget](https://www.tradingview.com/widget/advanced-chart/): Full-featured embeddable chart widget for websites and applications.
- [Symbol Overview Widget](https://www.tradingview.com/widget/symbol-overview/): Compact widget showing chart, price, and summary for a symbol.
- [Market Overview Widget](https://www.tradingview.com/widget/market-overview/): Multi-symbol market snapshot widget for grouped watchlists.
- [Ticker Tape Widget](https://www.tradingview.com/widget/ticker-tape/): Scrolling market ticker for displaying selected instruments.
- [Mini Chart Widget](https://www.tradingview.com/widget/mini-chart/): Lightweight embeddable chart for a single instrument.
- [Economic Calendar Widget](https://www.tradingview.com/widget/economic-calendar/): Embeddable calendar of macroeconomic events and releases.
- [Technical Analysis Widget](https://www.tradingview.com/widget/technical-analysis/): Widget summarizing technical signals for selected symbols.

## Trading & Broker Integration
- [Trading Panel](https://www.tradingview.com/trading/): Overview of supported brokers and in-platform trading workflow.
- [Paper Trading](https://www.tradingview.com/support/solutions/43000516466-paper-trading-main-functionality/): Simulated trading environment for testing strategies without real capital.
- [Broker Awards](https://www.tradingview.com/broker-awards/): Recognition program and rankings for integrated brokers on the platform.
- [Broker API](https://www.tradingview.com/broker-api/): Technical and business information for broker connectivity.
- [Supported Brokers](https://www.tradingview.com/brokers/): Directory of brokers available for chart trading integration.
- [TradingView Alerts](https://www.tradingview.com/support/folders/43000548797-alerts/): Help resources for creating and managing price and indicator alerts.
